title: Receipt ACK on a remote native relay mailbox fails with 404 'native mailbox association not found' after a successful read
outcome: After termal_read_mailbox successfully returns a page and receipt for a remote native relay mailbox, termal_acknowledge_mailbox with that exact mailbox id and unchanged receipt succeeds. Read and ACK resolve the same native mailbox association, with no 404.
acceptance: Receipt ACK on a remote native relay mailbox fails with 404 'native mailbox association not found' after a successful read is done
disposal_reason: Reporter copy error; no product defect established. Original reporter withdrew byte-identical retry claim and confirms malformed400/missing-association404 used hand-copied wrong IDs; no raw failing exact-input artifact exists. Current exact discovery/read/ACK succeed. Fable2 #1604 authorizes this disposition. No ownership relaxation or speculative recovery patch.
